Class MStore

java.lang.Object
jvmumps.MStore
All Implemented Interfaces:
StoreApi
public final class MStore extends Object implements StoreApi
In-memory StoreApi (direct-mode default; no persistence).

Not the M production model. RSM (the oracle) is always file-backed (RSM_DBFILE / rsm.dat with global buffers and database blocks). MStore is a JavaM/mJVM test and direct-mode backend only; for oracle-aligned persistence use SqlStore (integration) or live RSM.
